item.title: It’s just Field: Etsy witches and the energy price shock
item.description:
Inflation reached 4.2% in May…
Good day. What’s the only thing you need to complete a $100,000 wedding? For many brides, apparently, it’s a $14 “ Good Weather Spell ” from an Etsy witch. A Nerdwallet personal finance expert told Bloomberg, “Because the financial part of weddings feel so out of control, people are trying to do whatever they can to maintain control.” However, Etsy actually bans witches they catch selling supernatural spells on its platform, so it feels a bit risky.

item.title: Everyone’s mad: World Cup ticket algorithms and reversing aging
item.description:
Big World Cup matches are still not sold out...
Hallo. A German tourist named Freddy who’s visiting the US for the World Cup is going viral for documenting his quintessentially American experience. In the span of two days, he dined at Wendy’s, Chili’s, Waffle House, and Taco Bell, which he called “the holy land.”

item.title: Second bite: Apple's AI surrender and the SpaceX trillion
item.description:
Apple is expected to roll out a new take on Siri...
Good morning. A group of professional wrestlers is traveling to public libraries around the country to promote literacy by suplexing their way through storytime. Their show is called Lucha Libro . It got us thinking, what library-themed moves would we want to check out? We humbly suggest: the Dewey Decimator, the Spine Binder, the Skull Shusher, and the Due or Die.
